title: 2.1 Where people go
unit_outcome: Say where and how people go, what people have and what things are, compare people and things, and understand classroom commands in Spanish.
goal: Say where people go: Voy al gimnasio. Luis va al gimnasio. Ana va a la alberca.
grammar_function: ir a: voy/va + a la / al (a + el); ¿Adónde va…?; new places el gimnasio, la alberca, la oficina.
prerequisite: Spanish A1 Unit 2 and A1+ Unit 1.
